text: In accordance with Board of Directors of CreateTO Procedure By-law, the Board determines the place in Toronto, day and hour of its regular meetings and the schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, approved the 2026 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for the Board of Directors of CreateTO has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2026: Monday, January 26, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Friday, March 6, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Monday, April 27, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 2, City Hall/Video Conference Friday, June 12, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Monday, July 27, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference
